svg.title: Assembled - page 1
svg.text: A4 portrait — page 1 of 4 (sheet 1 of 9)
Section 1 of 3 - A4 portrait
Set to 210 x 297 mm, and the section after it is not. Look for the sheet changing size and
orientation at the boundary rather than the whole file taking one size, for the footer counting
twice - page n of this section, sheet n of the file - and for nothing flowing across the
boundary: what does not fit adds pages to its own section, which is what makes a table
changing width mid-continuation inexpressible rather than merely discouraged.
